decisions.reason: The product is closely related to the firm's existing salami and organic know-how, so management can learn and improve it, but the weaker website presence suggests only moderate internal confidence and a higher-than-average discontinuation risk.

As an organic poultry mini-salami snack, it builds strongly on the firm's established meat-processing and snack capabilities, and its dedicated product page indicates enough market and marketing support to justify continued refinement rather than withdrawal.

A premium salami sharing snack is very near the firm's existing competence base, and the dedicated page suggests the firm sees commercial potential and has sufficient knowledge to adjust positioning or recipe instead of dropping it quickly.
